Compare Cutpoint Selection Criteria

Source: R/km_cutpoints.R
plot_cutpoint_bar.Rd

`plot_cutpoint_bar()` draws one bar per selection criterion (median split, maximal log-rank, first significant cutpoint at each level, lowest p-value) of [km_cutpoint_search()] or [km_cutpoint_time_varying()], with the cutpoint value written on the bar. `plot_cutpoint_scatter()` places the same criteria at their cutpoint (x) and `-log10(p)` (y). Give a named list of results to compare several features, one panel each.

Usage

plot_cutpoint_bar(
  x,
  metric = c("neg_log10_p", "hr", "cutpoint"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  digits = 3
)

plot_cutpoint_scatter(x, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

x

A `cbe_km_cutpoint` object, a (named) list of them, or a data frame with `criterion`, `cutpoint` and `p_value` (and optionally `feature`, `hr`).

metric

What the bar height is: `"neg_log10_p"` (default), `"hr"` (hazard ratio of high versus low, on a log axis) or `"cutpoint"`.

alpha

Significance levels drawn as dotted reference lines when the y-axis is `-log10(p)` (default `0.05`; `NULL` for none).

digits

Significant digits of the cutpoint labels.

Value

A `ggplot2` object.

See also

[km_cutpoint_search()], [plot_km_cutpoints()], [plot_km_cutpoint()]

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(time = rexp(120, 0.1), status = rbinom(120, 1, 0.7), marker = rnorm(120))
res <- km_cutpoint_search(d, "time", "status", "marker")
plot_cutpoint_bar(res)

plot_cutpoint_scatter(res)
